newsitem.title: POLAND: Animex has no '97 convertible bond plan.
newsitem.headline: Animex has no '97 convertible bond plan.

text.p: Polish food trader and producer Animex SA does not plan a convertible bond issue this year, despite receiving shareholder approval on Wednesday to do so, the company's marketing director said on Thursday.
The shareholders approved an amendment in the firm's charter giving the firm the possibility to issue convertible bonds.

"Yesterday's motion has a universal character...we wanted to have the opportunity to consider such a possibility but it is not connected with any intentions, at least this year," Maria Przedpelska told Reuters.
